limits: Only manual UI save is responsive; initial entry/load/checkpoints remain synchronous.
Core1775 tests are reused only after exact Core/Tests/test-contract source, Core DLL and TRX hash comparison; no new full Core run or added Core tests is claimed.

Only these27 GPU processes were rerun: save success/failure with recovery, known-target movement, renewal with old mail, sender evidence, withdrawal, group/historical/ronin entry, old military/combat, ground material and three smokes. Other previous scenarios including repeated exercise were not rerun in this UI-only slice.

Real rendered frames and snapshot capture times are instrumented and include PNG output/validation load. No artificial delay is injected; neither measurements nor fixed60fps chronological video cuts establish performance targets or nationwide capacity.
Dense-unit label overlap and final terrain occlusion remain outside acceptance.

visual_review.method: 今回の実画像3枚（保存中・書込失敗・古い版の上書き保護）と完成動画を復号した2/4/6/10/12秒の5画像を個別に開き目視。競合操作無効化、失敗後の再試行、実ロード後の同じ3D、現地合流と指揮返還を確認。保存中静止画の1.5秒は読み取り用編集で、実描画数/保存時間として加算しない。密集ラベルは既存試作HUD制限。
